title: Member Benefit Note: Cartwise+ Plan Standing and the Unfound-Line Cap Share
content:
**Member benefit note — Cartwise Grocery Orders.** For a line billed although the shopper recorded its product as not found, the unfound-line cap share — the percentage of the cap basis that sets the refund room — follows the standing of the Cartwise+ Membership recorded on the order.

## Terms

The unfound-line cap share depends on the Cartwise+ membership recorded on the order:

- when that membership is on a **monthly plan** and the customer's membership ledger shows **at least 6 period fees** charged within the last **6 whole calendar months**, the share is **55 percent**;
- when that membership is on an **annual plan** and the ledger shows **at least 1 period fee** charged within the last **12 whole calendar months**, the share is **60 percent**;
- membership standing that meets neither description, or an order with no membership recorded, does not alter the unfound-line cap share.

Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date, so a period fee counts as charged within the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N such months have passed from its charge date to today, and a fee charged earlier in the current month is 0 months old.

## Truth table

| Plan on the order | Monthly plan, 6 or more period fees in last 6 whole months | Annual plan, 1 or more period fee in last 12 whole months | Cap share |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly | yes | — | 55 percent |
| Monthly | no (5 or fewer) | — | not altered |
| Annual | — | yes | 60 percent |
| Annual | — | no (none) | not altered |
| None recorded | — | — | not altered |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- An annual member whose only period fee was charged on 2 October of last year, looked at on 1 October this year: 11 anniversaries have fallen, fewer than 12, so the fee counts — 60 percent.
- The same member on 2 October this year: 12 anniversaries — the fee no longer counts and the share is not altered.
- A monthly member whose ledger shows exactly 6 counted period fees meets "at least 6" and takes 55 percent; with 5 the share is not altered.
